name: audiofab-reverb-hall-reverb
author: Audiofab
description: A classic hall reverb with a spacious, immersive sound. Ideal for adding depth and grandeur to any instrument.
controls: Pre-delay: Delay before the reverb tail starts.
Reverb Time: Length of the reverb tail.
Mix: Blend between dry and wet signal.
title: Hall Reverb

validation.scope: Native 32.768 kHz; inherited 16-bit delay model; software only, no hardware timing or fidelity claim.

name: audiofab-reverb-mn3011-reverb
author: Audiofab
description: An emulation of a classic BBD 'reverb' using the MN3011 bucket-brigade device model. Produces a warm, lo-fi reverb character with analog coloration.
controls: Repeats: Feedback amount — density of the reverb.
Mix: Blend between dry and wet signal.
title: MN3011 Reverb

validation.scope: Native 32.768 kHz; inherited 16-bit delay model; software only, no hardware timing or fidelity claim.

name: audiofab-reverb-plate-reverb
author: Jon Dattorro, mdroberts1243, Audiofab
description: A classic plate reverb derived from the Jon Dattorro design. Dense, smooth, and musically resonant with adjustable damping and decay.
controls: Damping: High-frequency loss in the reverb tank.
Reverb Time: Length of the reverb decay.

title: Plate Reverb

validation.scope: Native 32.768 kHz; inherited 16-bit delay model; software only, no hardware timing or fidelity claim.

name: audiofab-reverb-shimmer-reverb
author: DrAlx, Mick Taylor, Audiofab
